capabilities.description: Find all assets that reference a given asset path, categorized as Blueprint vs other references. The v2 response preserves the legacy package arrays and returns every object candidate for each referencer package with sourcePackagePath/sourceObjectPath/sourceClassPath/sourceIdentity, candidateCount, identityStatus, and ambiguity fields. For an object path it also performs an Asset Registry object-identifier query and returns targetIdentity, exactObjectReferencers, sourceAssetIdentifier, and sourceObjectReferenceExact so callers can distinguish package fallback from exact object evidence. The root identityStatus, referenceIdentityDigest, and identityComplete let callers detect incomplete or ambiguous Asset Registry resolution before following a cross-asset edit.
